description: Font loading optimizations and caching headers. The deployable SPA is in artifacts/electron/. Key findings: (1) artifacts/electron/index.html has Google Fonts for Orbitron, VT323, Nunito with display=swap - already good. (2) Cormorant Garamond and Comic Neue are loaded lazily via artifacts/electron/src/utils/loadFeatureFonts.ts (not blocking). (3) Root netlify.toml and vercel.json exist at /projects/sandbox/electron/ and are the deployed config. No [[headers]] blocks exist yet. Improvements: add cache headers to root netlify.toml and root vercel.json for /assets/ static files, add preload hint for Google Fonts CSS in artifacts/electron/index.html.
steps: 1. Read /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron/index.html. Note the Google Fonts link URL and confirm display=swap is present in the URL query params.

2. In /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron/index.html, add a `<link rel="preload" as="style" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700;900&family=VT323&family=Nunito:wght@700;800;900&display=swap" />` tag placed BEFORE the existing <link rel="stylesheet"> for Google Fonts. This triggers the font CSS download earlier without blocking render.

3. Read /projects/sandbox/electron/netlify.toml. Add `[[headers]]` blocks for cache control. Append to the file:
```
[[headers]]
  for = "/assets/*"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"

[[headers]]
  for = "/index.html"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "no-cache"

[[headers]]
  for = "/*.js"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"

[[headers]]
  for = "/*.css"
  [headers.values]
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
```
5. Run pnpm run typecheck to confirm no TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: artifacts/electron/index.html has a preload link for Google Fonts before the stylesheet link
netlify.toml at root has [[headers]] with immutable cache for /assets/* and no-cache for /index.html
vercel.json at root has headers array with immutable cache for assets and no-cache for /index.html
findings: All changes implemented successfully. Added preload link for Google Fonts in index.html, cache headers to netlify.toml and vercel.json. The pnpm run typecheck failure (TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'dom-chromium-installation-events') is pre-existing on the base branch and unrelated to this feature.
